Forward-port of #5 from `release/1.0.x` to `main`, opened by the forward-port action.

Merge this, or close it with a comment saying why `main` doesn't need the change.

To fix this port by hand (a failing check, or a change `main` needs adjusted), switch to its branch, commit the fix there and push it:

```sh
git fetch origin forward-port/release-1.0.x/5/main
git switch forward-port/release-1.0.x/5/main
git push
```

See [how to forward-port a fix](https://github.com/VectorLearning/cicd-standards/blob/main/docs/how-to/release-please-fixes-and-hotfixes.md#how-do-i-forward-port-a-fix-to-main).
